text: The Edmund S. Muskie Internship Program is a professional exchange initiative supported by the United States Department of State, established by Congress in fiscal year 1992 and named under the Freedom Support Act of 1992. It provides summer internship placements, career training, and financial support specifically to Eurasian scholars and graduate students studying in the United States. The program was relaunched with a renewed format and scope by Cultural Vistas in 2015; previously, it was administered by the International Research & Exchanges Board and the American Council of Teachers of Russian/American Council for Collaboration in Education and Language.
